deliveryConsent.title: Ukwabana amashina ne ba delivery
deliveryConsent.description: Vergeo5 ibomfya ama-courier ayakwata licence pa ma-delivery yamo. Pa kuleta order yenu, courier alefwaya ishina lyenu, nambala ya foni ne address ya delivery. Tulabapeela fye nga mwasuminisha. Pickup tailefwaya ifi.
deliveryConsent.label: Peeleni courier ishina lyandi, foni ne address pa kuleta ama-order yandi
deliveryConsent.grantedAt: Mwasuminishe pa {at}. Kuti mwaleka ilyo lyonse.
deliveryConsent.notGranted: Tamusuminishe. Abantu ba Vergeo5 balaleta order beka, nangu balamwipusha ilyo bashilabomfya courier.
deliveryConsent.loadFailed: Twafilwa ukusanga ifyo mwasala. Esheni na kabili.
deliveryConsent.saveFailed: Twafilwa ukusunga ifyo mwasala. Esheni na kabili.
